use: Hoping for something good, or expectations placed on someone.

example.ja: あんまり期待しないでね。
example.english: Don't get your hopes up too much.

examplePolite.romaji: amari kitai shinai de kudasai ne.
examplePolite.ja: あまり期待しないでくださいね。

notes: Kitai shiteru yo = I'm counting on you. Kitaihazure = a letdown.

english: put up with; hold back; hold it in
use: Enduring pain or waiting, or holding back from something you want.

example.ja: もうちょっと我慢して。
example.english: Hang in there a bit longer.

examplePolite.ja: もう少し我慢してください。
examplePolite.english: Please bear with it a little longer.

notes: Mou gaman dekinai = I can't take it anymore.

example.romaji: ima yaranai to, zettai koukai suru yo.
example.ja: 今やらないと、絶対後悔するよ。
example.english: If you don't do it now, you'll regret it.

examplePolite.romaji: ima yaranai to, kitto koukai shimasu yo.
examplePolite.ja: 今やらないと、きっと後悔しますよ。
examplePolite.english: If you don't do it now, you'll regret it.

notes: Koukai shitenai = I have no regrets.

use: Asking a customer or superior whether they know something: gozonji desu ka?
notes: Your own knowing is humble: zonjimasen = I don't know. Gozonji no toori = as you know.

example.ja: そんなの、想像もしてなかった。

examplePolite.romaji: sonna koto wa souzou mo shite imasen deshita.
examplePolite.ja: そんなことは想像もしていませんでした。

notes: Souzou dekinai = I can't imagine. Souzou ijou = beyond what I imagined.

use: A step more formal than wakaru; also being understanding toward someone.

example.romaji: oya ga zenzen rikai shite kurenai.
example.ja: 親が全然理解してくれない。
example.english: My parents just don't understand me.

examplePolite.romaji: oya ga zenzen rikai shite kuremasen.
examplePolite.ja: 親が全然理解してくれません。
examplePolite.english: My parents just don't understand me.

notes: Day to day, wakaru is the usual 'understand'.

english: worry about; agonise over; be torn
use: Being troubled by something or stuck on a choice: X de nayamu.

example.romaji: dotchi ni suru ka mada nayanderu.
example.ja: どっちにするかまだ悩んでる。
example.english: I still can't decide which one to pick.

examplePolite.romaji: dochira ni suru ka mada nayande imasu.
examplePolite.ja: どちらにするかまだ悩んでいます。
examplePolite.english: I'm still deciding which one to pick.

notes: Nayami = a worry, a problem. Shinpai suru is fearing what might happen.

english: get the wrong idea; mistake (one thing for another)

example.romaji: gomen, ashita da to kanchigai shiteta.
example.ja: ごめん、明日だと勘違いしてた。
example.english: Sorry, I thought it was tomorrow.

examplePolite.romaji: sumimasen, ashita da to kanchigai shite imashita.
examplePolite.ja: すみません、明日だと勘違いしていました。
examplePolite.english: Sorry, I thought it was tomorrow.

notes: Kanchigai shinai de = don't get the wrong idea. Machigai is a mistake you make; kanchigai is a wrong belief.
